newsitem.title: GERMANY: Karstadt surges on, rumour mill grinds.
newsitem.headline: Karstadt surges on, rumour mill grinds.

text.p: Shares in German retailer Karstadt AG resumed their rally on Thursday morning amid a wave of analyst enthusiasm for a pilot project to revamp outlets and market talk on a series of possible changes in the company.
The shares, which had surged six percent in bourse trade on Wednesday, led the field in pre-bourse trade to rise 35.50 marks, or nearly five percent to 722 marks at 0657 GMT.
The IBIS DAX index was up 1.2 percent at 4,272.10 points.

Dealers said there was no new factor moving the share, but that the market was still awash with positive speculation about Karstadt's future. There was talk of a European buyer taking an interest in the company, one dealer said.
Several analysts have upgraded Karstadt in recent days, despite talk that the company will be ousted from the blue chip DAX index in favour of Adidas AG in the upcoming index reshuffle.
Analysts are hoping for a broader application of a pilot programme which reorganises Karstadt's department store layout and has brought in significant additional profit.
There is also talk that the company will transformed into a holding firm and its units listed separately.
